name: Playden
description: Native PS5 homebrew Steam library launcher for jailbroken consoles. Sign in to Steam by QR code, browse and search your library, download Windows games, manage favorites and collections, sync Steam Cloud saves and launch installed games as individual PS5 home-screen titles. Games run through prospero-win, Wine and Vulkan with support for DXVK, controller input, mouse and keyboard, per-game settings and internal or external storage.
author: leolobato
